subsystems.label: PWA
subsystems.source_assessment: Current main contains one separately installable Zero/Go/Hub PWA, distinct from apps/web and native mobile. Its shipped app.mjs remains a static mode/connectivity shell and does not import the projection client or working set. The GET-only createPwaProjectionClient and normalizePwaContext/PwaProjectionWorkingSet exist under apps/pwa/src, but build.mjs copies only public/ into the deployable shell, so those modules are not shipped to the browser. #302/#1183 is now merged: packages/titan-platform provides cryptographic session credential verification, durable canonical company/device session resolution and an opt-in server-side CurrentWebSessionAdapter. That adapter expects trusted upstream authentication, a configured registry and an approved company-to-legacy-account mapping; apps/web does not yet compose it into its routes. Existing apps/web/app/api/v1/bootstrap still uses getSession/accountId, while the separate zero interaction route uses its web runtime; neither is a PWA bootstrap. The PWA has no authenticated, server-verified session/context bootstrap or configured projection endpoint. services/workforce/src/server.ts exposes POST /v1/workforce/conversations plus health/readiness and optional /v1/directadmin/* forwarding, not a general PWA projection GET. Server Node GET /v1/bootstrap is node-token control metadata only; the DirectAdmin /v1/directadmin/titan_workforce/projection route is panel-specific. A PWA context adapter must receive only host-verified company_id, actor_id, device_id and exact session/context revisions; client-selected mode or context cannot establish authority. The PWA currently models session_revision as a string while #302 CurrentSessionContext exposes it as a number, so the host contract must define an exact safe serialization. Streaming remains completed-response serialization rather than incremental event delivery or durable replay, and no PWA conversation, cancel or governed offline replay consumer is shipped.
missing_requirements: Integrate the merged #302 verifier and durable current-company session context through an explicit host-owned PWA auth/bootstrap contract. CurrentWebSessionAdapter is opt-in server-side composition, not a PWA route; keep credentials within the host authentication boundary and pass only server-resolved company_id, actor_id, device_id, context_revision and precisely serialized session revision. Do not derive authority from mode or client-supplied company identity.

Under #811, expose or commission the host-owned authenticated projection and conversation contracts usable by PWA, binding every response/request to that resolved context. Current Workforce exposes no general projection GET; its SSE writer runs after awaited dispatch and Last-Event-ID filters the completed response array, so incremental delivery and durable resume still need host work. Do not treat Server Node control-metadata /v1/bootstrap or DA-only /v1/directadmin/titan_workforce/projection as PWA APIs. #1049/#812 own SDK/Server Node composition if that is the serving path.

Within #1171, package the existing PWA helper modules into the shell build/service-worker cache and render projection plus explicit unconfigured/auth-required/stale/unavailable/canceled states after the #302/#811 host contract is available. Then implement revision-bound stream resume/cancel and bounded encrypted offline evidence staging with server-revalidated governed replay. No physical-browser or production-host certification is established.

subsystems.label: Native mobile
subsystems.source_assessment: The client recognizes zero/go/hub, but TitanSession carries company/actor/device/surface without session_id or context_revision. Its conversation request is a Future<Map> returning completed items and omits the hosted contract required interaction_id, client_message_id and session_id; it has no event-stream parser, continuation action/token or cancellation API. It expects an items array and authority_neutral response flag, while the current host returns schema_version plus events and no such flag. The host requires an authenticated session whose company, actor, device, surface, session and context_revision match exactly. The mobile test fake returns rev-13 after a rev-12 request and the client accepts it because it checks only that the response revision is nonempty. The host can serialize a completed dispatch result as JSON or SSE, but its SSE writer runs after awaited dispatch and Last-Event-ID filters that completed event array; this is not incremental delivery or reconnectable event-log replay. The hosted runtime currently rejects Go/Hub. The shell keeps the user text and displays one generic reachability/sign-in error. A separate offline command replay service/planner exists and requires server revalidation, but it is not conversation replay or evidence of client integration. Release certification code validates evidence fields; no signed physical-device result is established here.
missing_requirements: Align the native adapter with the authenticated host DTO: include exact session, interaction and client-message identity from the verified current session; require exact context revision; consume events instead of items; and support true incremental delivery, durable event replay/resume and explicit cancel. Add a server-owned Go/Hub contract before claiming all three hosted modes. Wire logout/company/context revision rotation to clearing private cached and queued work, connect offline replay to current server revalidation, and map auth/stale/unconfigured/unavailable/cancel states distinctly. #302/#1183 now supplies the canonical verifier and durable session primitive; #1049 host/SDK composition and #1182/#1188 client continuity remain distinct. Physical signed iOS/Android Zero/Go/Hub certification is unrun.

subsystems.label: DirectAdmin Business Node
subsystems.source_assessment: Current main includes the loopback Server Node health bridge and the #1211 partial control API/DirectAdmin relay. The control API uses a node transport bearer and its /v1/bootstrap response is control_metadata_only; a canonical adapter is not commissioned, so lifecycle/recovery submissions remain unavailable/refused. The browser relay maps a fixed DirectAdmin RAW route set to the optional Workforce gateway, including GET /v1/directadmin/titan_workforce/projection. That projection is a DirectAdmin-panel adapter bound to its host/session context, not a PWA bootstrap or general PWA projection endpoint. The Workforce server only mounts /v1/directadmin/* when its operator-configured gateway is present. The Server Node README explicitly describes partial/fail-closed implementation and no live root installation. Current source includes the optional Titan Dev Access plugin (#1048): its PHP form offers diagnostics, bounded account-local commands, and SSH public-key add/fingerprint/revoke. USER-REPORTED only: the portal is installed with diagnostics and its public-key POST rejects malformed/ambiguous form data. No live portal interaction occurred; live command execution and key lifecycle remain UNVERIFIED.
missing_requirements: Complete #812-owned Server Node host commissioning through the merged #302 identity verifier/session registry, #1049 SDK and #811 Workforce composition: exact artifact install/update/rollback/reboot/recovery, canonical adapter commissioning, company-scoped authority and observed outcomes. Current tests are fixture/loopback evidence; no live DirectAdmin install, root action, provider operation, or business outcome was verified.

Complete #1048-owned Developer Portal/Dev Access acceptance through the shared #1049 SDK and #302 session/credential boundaries: verify form parsing/rejection, CSRF, valid public-key add/fingerprint/revoke, account-scoped command output and permissions on the actual installation. Preserve the malformed/ambiguous POST behavior as user-reported until independently reproduced; command/key lifecycle remains UNVERIFIED.

subsystems.label: Workforce
subsystems.source_assessment: Current main, including merged #811/#1201, contains a hosted runtime composed over durable SQLite run/work stores, cryptographically verified Workforce credentials, current identity-session resolution, company/session/context-revision binding, idempotent request/recovery, continuation and cancellation paths. POST /v1/workforce/conversations supports JSON and SSE and projects a bounded public event set. The server waits for dispatch/recovery/cancel to finish before writing the response; SSE and Last-Event-ID only serialize/filter the completed event array, not live incremental delivery or durable event-log replay. The hosted Workforce contract currently commissions the Zero surface; Go/Hub are rejected pending their authority-aware dispatcher. Code and local/CI tests establish implementation-level behavior, not a live commissioned host, production credential/provider operation or reboot/backup acceptance.
missing_requirements: Run the clean-host commissioning, exact artifact/hash, real credential/provider, reboot/update/rollback and recovery acceptance in docs/operations/workforce-clean-host-acceptance.md. Deliver actual incremental stream and durable event resume plus broader mobile lifecycle under #1182; keep the host runtime at Zero-only until Go/Hub have their own authority-aware contract. Production/live-host and physical-client evidence remains outstanding.
